description: This file contains test definitions for manufacturing production runs in an OFBiz-based project. It defines multiple testing methods that simulate creating, scheduling, confirming, changing dates, canceling, and completing production runs, including cost calculations and inventory adjustments.

methods.name: testProductionRunCreation
methods.description: Tests creation of a production run and verifies its properties and related entities.

methods.name: testProductionRunScheduleConfirm
methods.description: Tests changing the status of a production run to scheduled and confirmed, verifying status updates.

methods.name: testProductionRunDateChange
methods.description: Tests updating the start date of a production run and verifies that the estimated times are recalculated properly.

methods.name: testProductionRunCancelled
methods.description: Tests cancelation of a production run and the associated inventory and status updates.

methods.name: testProductionRunQuickIssueAndProduce
methods.description: Simulates quick issuance of materials and production of finished products during a production run, including inventory and cost adjustments.

methods.name: testQuickRunProductionRun
methods.description: Performs a quick execution of a production run and verifies completion.

methods.name: testQuickCloseProductionRun
methods.description: Finalizes a production run and verifies that all entities are appropriately updated to a closed status.

methods.name: testCreateProductionRunForOrder
methods.description: Creates a production run aligned with an order and verifies related workflow and inventory statuses.

methods.name: testCreateProductionRunForRequirement
methods.description: Creates a production run based on a requirement, verifying the effort and entity states.
